checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Face, expression and pose look identical to the original.

must.item: Curly hair and sweater preserved with clean edges
must.why: Curls and knit sweater are intact with natural edges; fine flyaways are retained.

must.item: Sand and blue sea replace park
must.why: Turquoise sea, golden sand and a blue sky; no park remains.

must.item: Head-and-shoulders framing, no invented full body
Coherent photograph, not a pasted cutout
must.why: Lighting and saturation are fairly consistent. The sky is very saturated and the image looks slightly over-processed, but it is not a visible cutout.

faults.what: The whole image has a slightly boosted, saturated, HDR-like look, including the skin tone. The sky is overly vivid and the horizon is a bit flat.

summary: The park is replaced by a convincing sunny beach with sand, sea and sky. The subject and framing are preserved and the image stays square; the only flaw is slightly over-saturated colour.
